description: This file defines the `TableSwitch` class, a subclass of `Table`, responsible for managing switch-type tables within the RomRaider application. It handles GUI components such as radio buttons for switch states, manages data size, populates table data from ROM input, saves changes back to byte arrays, and supports comparison functionalities. The class is specifically used to represent toggle or switch settings in the ROM mapping context.
